reference_opening.argument: This video is non-scam content because it primarily provides technical market commentary about Cardano and Bitcoin, including qualified views about possible future performance rather than guaranteed returns. Optional memberships and Patreon access are presented as paid access to charts and Discord updates with visible tiered pricing, which is ordinary audience monetization. The video also warns that crypto can cause losses and that alleged account-management or money solicitations should be avoided.

the people who end up waiting during the bear market and the people who just stay in the market, even if the market goes down for like months or even years, are the people who are probably gonna do extremely well in

This video is for entertainment purposes only. It is not financial advice and is not an endorsement of any provider, product, asset or service.

opening.argument: The title pairs Cardano with a price prediction, while the speaker says people who remain in the market through the bear market will probably do extremely well in the next cycle. That links a favorable future-return claim to continued market participation, not merely to observing the market. The forecast is not guaranteed, but its persuasive force is to make holding through prolonged declines seem like a path to doing well. The chart presentation reinforces that investment-oriented message with projected downside levels and a possible later recovery scenario.

rebuttal.rebuttal: Calling the forecast qualified does not remove the action-linked appeal: the speaker associates staying in the market through a downturn with probably doing extremely well. The risk disclaimer warns of losses, but does not undo that favorable holding message. The membership pitch also gives viewers a way to continue following the analysis and charts.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The statement describes a general opinion about people who remain in the market; it does not tell viewers to buy Cardano, identify a required asset or amount, or promise a specific return. The video also explicitly warns of loss and describes a bear market that may continue, including possible further declines. Paid memberships are for charts and updates, not a stated route to investment returns.

opening.argument: This is crypto price-prediction content framed around Cardano and a title that singles out “The 1%.” The speaker forecasts that Cardano will do very well in the next cycle and says market participants who stay through declines will probably do extremely well. At the same time, the description directs viewers to paid Patreon membership, and the video promotes membership access to charts and daily Discord updates. Together, an optimistic holding narrative and a paid channel for ongoing market guidance can encourage viewers to keep participating while their asset is falling. The warnings and uncertainty language do not erase that combination.

They do not: the core message still presents staying invested as likely to produce strong results, while paid access supplies more charts and continuing updates. A warning about losses may reduce certainty, but it does not eliminate the promotional pull of the forecast.
